sent_bad: Launched its own streaming service: "AT&T has announced plans to introduce a new edge provider—HBO Max—to stream video programming for no extra charge to AT&T customers who are also HBO subscribers; other customers will reportedly be charged a subscription fee." (doc.txt)

In short, the document shows ISPs transitioning into edge providers by (1) acquiring content creators or existing edge providers (AT&T/Time Warner, Comcast/NBCUniversal-Hulu, Verizon/AOL and Yahoo) and (2) launching their own streaming or content services (HBO Max, Peacock, Oath).
